job.description: N18, the loop with the judge's data and weighting held fixed: the calibration run on seed 3001. Trains rw-cloop, rw-ctwin, rw-j20, rw-peer and rw-nfree at full length. Re-measures N17's calibration peer and five rungs (from the n17_calib Drive folder), N13's n80-rw, N12's sub20 and clean, N15's calibration rw-oracle, and N14's sub10, sub05 and sub025 of seed 3001 (from n13_calib, n12_calib, n15_calib and n14_calib) on the held-out tail's windows 513-1024, and compares rw-j20 and rw-peer with N17's saved calibration models. It first runs the setup checks; if any fails, it stops before training. NEEDS AN A100: before Run all, choose Runtime > Change runtime type > A100 GPU. On any other GPU it stops before training. About 40 minutes. Resumable: if a session ends, choose Run all again and finished work is skipped.
